scope: Remaining replay matrix after completed seed-42 1000 smoke and this attempted seed-42 10000 batch. Excludes complementary experiments and a retry of this stopped memory job.

groups.basis: Prior seed-42 smoke manifest interval, 14.23659 seconds, multiplied by 0.8 to 1.5 per batch.
Current total command wall time multiplied by 0.8 to 1.5 per batch. Worker timeouts can still leave incomplete memory data.

Assuming quadratic Baseline work for buildup/crowded/mixed/sweep, 16 Baseline phase workers are projected to reach the 60-second cap; the 900-second campaign deadline is expected to stop each batch first. This is a capped-attempt estimate, not a completion estimate.

uncertainty: Ranges are planning envelopes, not confidence intervals. Preparation for missing datasets and verification are additional and unmeasured. Same machine/load, unchanged engines, phase boundaries and workload settings are assumed. Seed-dependent depth and cleanup costs can change runtime.
large_model: 10x events -> 100x growing-depth Baseline work; near-linear Revised and I/O scaling. Several large workers are expected to time out during warm-up. The current worker timeout is not used as a single-replay timing.

uncapped_primary_only.assumption: Quadratic Baseline scaling; four growing-depth scenarios, one warm-up plus five measured replays, three seeds. Excludes I/O, latency, memory, diagnostics, data generation and orchestration.

prior_small_reference.caveat: Measurement-span proxy for small command wall time; preparation/startup are not separately known.
